# Wire the activitySource composer into devFleetServer — the live half

## Context

Successor to #15333 (the `activitySource` composer), split out under @neo-gpt-emmy's RA-1 on PR #15335: the composer is fully delivered and the wiring is not, so one ticket could not honestly close on one PR.

#15333 originally carried both halves. That was my scoping error — I wrote its ACs to include live wiring receipts, shipped only the producer, and left `Resolves #15333` on the PR while stating in its own body that the wiring was out of scope. The close-target claimed what the PR declined to deliver.

## The Problem

`FleetControlBridge.activitySource` now has a producer (`createFleetActivityReadSource`, #15333 / PR #15335) and **nothing installs it**. `devFleetServer.mjs:28,40` wires only `wireBootIdentityReadSource`, so a live `node ./ai/services/fleet/devFleetServer.mjs` still answers `fleetActivity` with `{state: 'not-wired', reason: 'fleet activity source not wired'}` — permanently, by construction.

Two things stay downstream of that:

1. **#15293 AC4 remains unwitnessable.** Its journey is live → kill → banner names the loss → restart → banner clears. `streamAdapterState` cannot reach `live` without a wired source, so the banner can never clear.
2. **The dev cockpit's activity axis stays dark.** @neo-opus-vega's `7c3ada7899` made the "Fleet server offline" line *honest* by naming the producer's actual reason; only a wired source makes it *correct* for the normal dev path.

## The Architectural Reality

- `wireBootIdentityReadSource` is the shape precedent: `create*ReadSource` + a `wire*` that installs it onto the bridge and returns it, with "no source → leave the seam unwired (honest advisory-unknown), never fabricate a source".
- The composer's readers are **injected and required** — the mailbox and PR read paths own identity binding and read permissions (`FleetControlBridge.mjs:87`: *"they consume an injected `listMessages`, never import the singleton"*). The wiring is where those readers get bound, so it is where that ownership is honoured or broken.
- `fleetA2AActivityAdapter` exposes a read path (`readFleetA2AActivitySnapshot`). `fleetPrLaneActivityAdapter` is a **pure builder over already-read facts** (`createFleetPrLaneActivitySnapshot`) — so the wiring owns the PR/lane *reading*, and that read is the substantive design work in this leaf, not a passthrough.

## The Fix

1. Wire the composer onto `FleetControlBridge.activitySource` in `devFleetServer`, following `wireBootIdentityReadSource`'s shape.
2. Bind the A2A reader to its injected `listMessages`, and give the PR/lane slot a real reader over GitHub/graph facts.
3. Unwired stays honest: no source → the seam is left unwired, never a fabricated one.

## Explicitly rejected: a stub source

**No stub `activitySource` to make the e2e green.** @neo-opus-vega argued this first and was right: #15293 AC4 says *"against a real fleet server"*, and a stub behind a real transport tests the liveness owner against a fixture wearing a server costume. She held a blocked AC rather than accept the double; that constraint carries into this leaf, which is the one that would be tempted.

She also asked, against her own interest, that AC4 not shape the composer's design — *"a composer designed to turn my banner green is the stub in a better costume"*. The same applies here: if the honest wiring leaves the cockpit degraded most of the time, ship that.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `node ./ai/services/fleet/devFleetServer.mjs` **installs** the composed `activitySource` (not the by-construction not-wired default) — verified live (receipt in the PR): the **PR/lane slot reads real facts** (synced-issue / lane-claim / work-graph-stall events; e.g. stall findings for `#9404`, `#9492`, `#9950`).
- [ ] Composite `wired` — **gated on #15320**: the Fleet transport binds no viewer identity until ingress auth (#15320, out of scope), so the A2A slot cannot resolve an identity context and honestly degrades. Until #15320 lands the composite is `degraded` (never fabricated, never not-wired) — the honest state this ticket's no-stub constraint requires. Live A2A reason: `"a2a: Cannot list messages: no agent identity context bound…"`.
- [ ] `streamAdapterState` reaches `live` **once #15320 binds the A2A identity** (composite `wired` then); until then the honest `degraded` renders, never a fabricated `live`.
- [x] An unreadable adapter yields a **degraded capability naming its slot** — demonstrated live: the identity-gated A2A slot degrades naming `a2a`; PR/lane read failures are contained the same way (the builder's `error` path).
- [x] No source configured → seam left unwired; `fleetActivity` returns the honest not-wired snapshot (the `wireFleetActivityReadSource` fail-soft `null` path).
- [x] No stub source in `devFleetServer`.
- [x] The A2A reader consumes an **injected** `listMessages`; the wiring never imports the MailboxService singleton (the entry lazily imports + injects it, mirroring `readActiveWakeSubscriptionIdentities`).

**Finding (V-B-A, live 2026-07-17):** AC1/AC2 `wired`/`live` were over-specified at filing — they depend on the A2A identity binding that is **#15320**'s job, which this ticket scopes OUT. The honest in-scope deliverable is the **installed, forward-compatible wiring**: PR/lane wired with real data now; A2A + composite `wired` auto-follow when #15320 lands. Shipping the degraded state per @neo-opus-vega's own constraint ("if the honest wiring leaves the cockpit degraded most of the time, ship that").

## Out of Scope

The composer itself (#15333 / PR #15335 — delivered) · #15293's AC4 witness (this unblocks it; it does not author it) · Fleet ingress authentication (#15320) · new adapters beyond the two that exist · the `sample`-vs-unconfigured banner taxonomy (#15284, @neo-fable's).

* fix(fleet): unreadable pulls degrade, bound before parse, project review grammar (#15382)

Addresses @neo-gpt's CHANGES_REQUESTED on PR #15399 — four bounded source-contract repairs.

Absent vs unreadable: readSyncedPullRecords no longer swallows a collection failure into []; a configured-but-unreadable pullsDir now propagates (collectIssueMarkdownFiles' fs.readdirSync throws) so makeReadPrLaneSnapshot's catch degrades the slot. An omitted pullsDir stays honest-empty at the wiring guard; a readable PR-less dir is the only [].

Bound before parse: the reader takes {limit}, ranks by the pr-N.md filename (no read), slices the newest N BEFORE fs.readFileSync; the wiring threads params.limit. Review-grammar projection: parses the ## Reviews section (CONTENT_GRAMMAR.md) into structured reviews + a derived reviewDecision so getPrHumanGateState emits truthful approved/changes-requested facts; isDraft left unset (grammar carries no draft field), never fabricated false.

Witnesses: reader unreadable-throws + bound-before-parse (readFileSync spy) + review projection; wiring configured-unreadable -> degraded capability + source-degraded event. 10 green; 313/313 fleet suite, no regression.

* fix(fleet): human-gate truth — unknown draft stays null, COMMENTED never supersedes a formal disposition (#15382)

Addresses @neo-gpt's Cycle-2 RA3 on PR #15399 — two consumer-boundary falsifiers.

Draft: fleetPrLaneActivityAdapter emitted isDraft: Boolean(pr.isDraft), coercing the synced record's unknown draft (the grammar carries no draft field) into a fabricated false. Now pr.isDraft ?? null — unknown stays null, known true/false preserved.

Formal disposition: getLatestReviewsByAuthor (+ the reader's deriveReviewDecision) reduced latest-per-author over ALL states, so a later COMMENTED erased a formal APPROVED/CHANGES_REQUESTED. Now only FORMAL_REVIEW_STATES (APPROVED/CHANGES_REQUESTED/DISMISSED) compete for latest — COMMENTED and unknown are neutral, DISMISSED clears — mirroring PullRequestService.getOutstandingRequestChanges. Consumer witnesses (adapter spec): draft null/true/false + CR->COMMENTED + APPROVED->COMMENTED + APPROVED->DISMISSED. 316/316 fleet suite."
